53e1cfaad5e0566e4ea1.headline: Spain outlines plans for AI cooperation before regional summit
53e1cfaad5e0566e4ea1.summary: Spain says countries are working on AI together ahead of the Ibero-American Summit. Plans cover shared access to data, AI tools for local languages and computer power.

eefc381d2bfb99dc1716.headline: Sweden joins European talks on AI and society
eefc381d2bfb99dc1716.summary: Sweden says its prime minister will attend European meetings in Dublin. Leaders plan to discuss how AI could affect European businesses and society.

3090da02f395b8809131.headline: Slovenia sets up a council to advise on AI
3090da02f395b8809131.summary: Slovenia says it has created a 48-member council on AI and digital services. The group will advise the prime minister on developing and using AI.

2e8803a578995adb3b60.headline: Spain warns about fake sexual images made with AI
2e8803a578995adb3b60.summary: Spain has presented a campaign about AI-made sexual images shared without consent. The government calls this violence against women and urges people to take responsibility for what they share.

45c2e6222fa2bcdee437.headline: Estonia calls for stronger and safer European AI
45c2e6222fa2bcdee437.summary: Estonia says European leaders will discuss how to build more AI in Europe and use it safely. Its prime minister calls for AI that people can trust and control.

24fdfa2b534e112c3d66.headline: Moldova discusses AI projects with the World Bank
24fdfa2b534e112c3d66.summary: Moldova says its prime minister discussed possible AI projects with the World Bank. The talks covered using new technology to help people get work done and testing new ideas in Moldova.

13446e75e78b5701a66c.headline: White House links AI data centres to its infrastructure plans
13446e75e78b5701a66c.summary: The White House says it is investing in data centres for advanced AI. It says technology companies have agreed to pay for the extra power and grid upgrades their centres need, instead of passing those costs to households.

6857c69aceb6a6926df6.headline: UK plans to make AI a priority at the G20
6857c69aceb6a6926df6.summary: The UK says its prime minister discussed AI benefits and risks with France’s president. It plans to put AI high on the agenda during its 2027 G20 presidency and work on shared international standards.
